problem: Binary 'tests passed' rewards miss nuanced code quality issues like performance regressions, style violations, and security problems.
solution: Use a multi-criteria code review critic that decomposes quality into subcriteria (correctness, style, perf, security) with explainable subscores.
when: When code quality beyond correctness matters
pros: Higher code quality via non-functional criteria
cons: Critic model maintenance as standards evolve
